draft_email.subject: Windward Logistics: champion gap and support tickets
draft_email.body:
Hi Isaac,

Hope you're having a good Monday morning. At Windward Logistics we've had Grace Abara depart 39 days ago with no replacement named, and we currently have four open high-or-urgent support tickets (integration sync failures, data export issues) with strongly negative sentiment. I'd like to align on replacing the champion and getting the tickets prioritized. Are you available for a quick 15-min call this week?

Best,
[Your Name]

draft_email.subject: Re-engaging Highmoor Components after champion departure
draft_email.body:
Hi Olivia,

I'm reaching out because our named champion, Ines Osei, departed 36 days ago and no replacement has been named. Since then, product usage has dropped 51.7% over 16 weeks (from 18.1 to 8.8 avg weekly active users), and invoice INV-90080 is 42 days overdue.

We previously trialed an adoption workshop, but the account continues to decline. I'd like to onboard a new champion to re-energize the relationship and get usage back on track. Are you available for a brief call early next week to discuss?

Best,
[Your Name]

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Chooses which accounts to investigate and the hypotheses to test

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Writes churn-risk claims, each citing a Zetaris fact

agents.name: Verifier
agents.role: Rejects claims the data does not support, sends drafts back when a signal is missed, checks the Skeptic's rulings

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.role: Argues against every claim and looks for innocent explanations

agents.name: Escalation
agents.role: Escalates high-risk, high-revenue or near-renewal accounts

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes the brief, the recommended play and a draft email

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Recalls earlier weeks per account, stores this week's verdict, rewards helpful memories
